class AgentState(TypedDict):
    # Conversation / request
    messages: Annotated[list, add_messages]
    query: NotRequired[str]
    request: NotRequired[Dict[str, Any]]

    # Execution context
    run_id: NotRequired[str]
    workspace: NotRequired[str]
    status: NotRequired[str]
    scene: NotRequired[Dict[str, Any]]
    params: NotRequired[Dict[str, Any]]

    # Investigation result
    investigation: NotRequired[Dict[str, Any]]
    inference: NotRequired[Dict[str, Any]]
    findings: NotRequired[List[Dict[str, Any]]]
    confidence: NotRequired[Dict[str, Any]]
    assessment: NotRequired[Dict[str, Any]]
    artifacts: NotRequired[Dict[str, Any]]

    # Enhancement result
    enhancement: NotRequired[Dict[str, Any]]
    enhancement_rounds: NotRequired[int]
    reviewed: NotRequired[bool]
    review_decision: NotRequired[Dict[str, Any]]
    route: NotRequired[str]

    # Output
    final_answer: NotRequired[str]
    error: NotRequired[Optional[str]]

    # Observability
    audit: Annotated[List[Dict[str, Any]], merge_audit]
    route_history: List[str]

def build_graph(runtime: Any, checkpointer: Optional[Any] = None):
    """Compile the top-level graph.

    A checkpointer is required for human-in-the-loop ``interrupt`` calls.  The
    default in-memory saver is fine for a demo; production should use
    ``SqliteSaver``/Postgres so reviews survive process restarts.
    """
    builder = StateGraph(AgentState)
    builder.add_node("supervisor", lambda s: to_python(supervisor_node(s, runtime)))
    builder.add_node("investigation_workflow", build_investigation_graph(runtime))
    builder.add_node("enhancement_workflow", build_enhancement_graph(runtime))
    builder.add_node("finish", lambda s: to_python(finish_node(s, runtime)))

    builder.add_edge(START, "supervisor")
    builder.add_conditional_edges(
        "supervisor",
        lambda s: s.get("route", "finish"),
        {
            "investigation": "investigation_workflow",
            "enhancement": "enhancement_workflow",
            "finish": "finish",
        },
    )
    builder.add_edge("investigation_workflow", "supervisor")
    builder.add_edge("enhancement_workflow", "supervisor")
    builder.add_edge("finish", END)

    return builder.compile(checkpointer=checkpointer or MemorySaver())

def build_investigation_graph(runtime: Any):
    def node(fn):
        return lambda s: to_python(fn(s, runtime))

    builder = StateGraph(AgentState)
    builder.add_node("plan", node(plan_node))
    builder.add_node("prepare", node(prepare_node))
    builder.add_node("infer", node(infer_node))
    builder.add_node("postprocess", node(postprocess_node))
    builder.add_node("assess", node(assess_node))
    builder.add_node("abort", node(abort_node))

    builder.add_edge(START, "plan")
    builder.add_conditional_edges(
        "plan",
        lambda s: "abort" if s.get("status") == "needs_clarification" else "prepare",
        {"abort": "abort", "prepare": "prepare"},
    )
    builder.add_conditional_edges(
        "prepare",
        lambda s: "abort" if s.get("status") == "error" else "infer",
        {"abort": "abort", "infer": "infer"},
    )
    builder.add_conditional_edges(
        "infer",
        lambda s: "abort" if s.get("status") == "error" else "postprocess",
        {"abort": "abort", "postprocess": "postprocess"},
    )
    builder.add_conditional_edges(
        "postprocess",
        lambda s: "abort" if s.get("status") == "error" else "assess",
        {"abort": "abort", "assess": "assess"},
    )
    builder.add_edge("assess", END)
    builder.add_edge("abort", END)
    return builder.compile()

def build_enhancement_graph(runtime: Any):
    def node(fn):
        return lambda s: to_python(fn(s, runtime))

    builder = StateGraph(AgentState)
    builder.add_node("diagnose", node(diagnose_node))
    builder.add_node("sweep", node(sweep_node))
    builder.add_node("reinfer", node(reinfer_node))
    builder.add_node("reassess", node(reassess_node))
    builder.add_node("review", node(review_node))
    builder.add_node("explain", node(explain_node))

    builder.add_edge(START, "diagnose")
    builder.add_conditional_edges(
        "diagnose",
        lambda s: (s.get("enhancement") or {}).get("next_action", "explain"),
        {
            "sweep": "sweep",
            "reinfer": "reinfer",
            "review": "review",
            "explain": "explain",
        },
    )
    builder.add_edge("sweep", "reassess")
    builder.add_edge("reinfer", "reassess")
    builder.add_conditional_edges(
        "reassess",
        lambda s: _route_after_reassess(s, runtime),
        {"reinfer": "reinfer", "review": "review", "explain": "explain"},
    )
    builder.add_edge("review", "explain")
    builder.add_edge("explain", END)
    return builder.compile()
